description: Entity Framework Core implementation of CQRS patterns using MediatR and Repository pattern with configurable Microsoft.Extensions.Logging support.
releaseNotes:
Version 3.1.8: Fixed ORA-00904 "P0": invalid identifier in UpdateFromQueryCommand / DeleteByQuery introduced in 3.1.7.
       - SQL parameter placeholders are now provider-specific (Oracle :p0, SQL Server @p0)
       Version 3.1.7: Fixed SQL parameter types in UpdateFromQueryCommand.
       - Parameters now respect IsUnicode(false), HasMaxLength and HasColumnType of the entity property (Varchar2 instead of NVarchar2 on Oracle)
       - Unsupported predicates now throw NotSupportedException instead of being silently dropped
       Version 3.1.6: Performance improvement - Added AsNoTracking() to specification-based read methods for better performance.
       Version 3.1.5: Fixed DBNull mapping issue in SQL parameters.
       - Fixed error: "No mapping to a relational type can be found for the CLR type 'DBNull'"
       - Replaced DBNull.Value with null in SQL parameters, EF Core handles null values correctly
       Version 3.1.4: Fixed parameter evaluation in UpdateFromQueryCommand for closure variables.
       - Fixed issue where closure variables (e.g., test.Name) in UpdateFromQueryCommand were not properly evaluated
       - SQL parameters now contain actual values instead of expression string representations
       - Resolves issue: Parameters contained expression string representations instead of actual values
       Version 3.1.3: Enhanced ValueConverter support for enum conversions with Description attributes.
       - Fixed double conversion for enum types: String enum names (e.g., "New") are now correctly converted to Description format (e.g., "NEW")
       - Added support for nullable enum conversions with proper null handling
       - Improved conversion logic to handle Int32, String, and Enum value types correctly
       - Removed debug logging for production-ready code
       Version 3.1.2: Bug fix release - Fixed ValueConverter support in ExecuteUpdate and ExecuteDelete operations.
       - UpdateFromQueryAsync and DeleteByQueryAsync now properly apply ValueConverter configured via HasConversion
       - Values are correctly converted from CLR type to database provider type before SQL execution
       - Fixes issues with enum-to-string, DateTime-to-long, and other custom value conversions
       Version 3.1.0: Updated to work with MKS.Repository.EntityFrameworkCore 3.1.0 (removed Z.EntityFramework.Plus dependency).
       - Compatible with custom ExecuteUpdate/ExecuteDelete implementations
       - All CQRS operations now use repository implementations without external bulk operation dependencies
       Version 3.0.0: Migrated to .NET Standard 2.0 with MediatR 12.2.0 and Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore 3.1.20.
       Removed Specification-based commands and queries for cleaner API surface.
       Breaking change: Removed all *BySpecification* commands and queries.
       All operations now use expression-based queries compatible with .NET Standard 2.0.
       Version 9.3.1: Added AutoCommit parameter to BeginTransactionQuery for explicit transaction control.
       New: AutoCommit parameter (default true) - when false, requires explicit CommitAsync/RollbackAsync in user code.
       Provides flexibility for advanced scenarios requiring conditional commit/rollback logic.
       Example with manual control: new BeginTransactionQuery<User>(AutoCommit: false)
       Version 9.3.0: Added comprehensive transaction support for CQRS operations.
       New: BeginTransactionQuery<TEntity> to initiate database transactions via MediatR.
       All command records now accept optional ITransactionScope parameter for multi-command transactions.
       Configurable AutoSaveChanges strategy: immediate (default) for early error detection or deferred for performance.
       Commands seamlessly integrate with transactions - simply pass transaction scope from BeginTransactionQuery.
       Example: using(var tx = await mediator.Send(new BeginTransactionQuery<User>())) { /* commands */ }
       Enhanced atomicity for complex business operations spanning multiple entities.
title: MKS CQRS Entity Framework Core
